name: Olli: Neozhidannoe puteshestvie
source: Oliver lives in a small village and works in the forge. One day his life changes when he meets a bearded wizard and is whisked on a journey full of wonders, dangers and lusty maidens. On his way he meets a variety of Disney characters.
translation: Oliver lives in a small village and works in the forge. One day his life changes when he meets a bearded wizard and is whisked on a journey full of wonders, dangers and lusty maidens. On his way he meets a variety of Disney characters.
